column1: # config/forge/hosts.tsv -- DATA for scripts/forge/forge.sh: which forge answers for which git host.
# TAB-separated columns: host  provider  api_base  token_vars  note
#   provider   one of github gitlab gitea gitflic gitverse (gitea covers Forgejo)
#   api_base   https only, no userinfo; the token is sent ONLY to this origin
#   token_vars comma list of variable NAMES looked up in order (env, keys file, project .env); never values
# A host with no row is GAP unknown_forge: nothing is guessed. Edit by recorded operator decision only.
